GSK to invest $800 million in Pennsylvania biopharma hub

GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) plans to invest over $800 million to expand its biopharmaceutical hub in Pennsylvania, a move expected to create 300 jobs. The company's investment will focus on enhancing its biopharma capabilities within the state.
